read.thesis: Q2 FY26 adjusted operating margin 6.9% (vs 6.3%) on US yields and cost cuts; FY26 EPS guide raised to $14.80–16.00 pre-MTM, but FedEx Freight profit fell 71% and capex held at $4.5B.

capex.quote: Capital spending of $4.5 billion, with a priority on investments in network optimization and efficiency improvement, including fleet and facility modernization and automation.

triggers.label: FY26 EPS floor raised to $14.80 from $14.20
triggers.quote: Diluted earnings per share of $14.80 to $16.00 before the MTM retirement plans accounting adjustments compared to the prior forecast of $14.20 to $16.00

triggers.label: Freight shipments down 4%, FedEx Freight profit -71%
triggers.quote: FedEx Freight segment operating results decreased during the quarter due to lower shipments

guidance.quote: A 5% to 6% revenue growth rate year over year, compared to the prior forecast of 4% to 6% revenue growth
Diluted earnings per share of $14.80 to $16.00 before the MTM retirement plans accounting adjustments
Pension contributions of $275 million, compared to the prior forecast of up to $400 million.
Permanent cost reductions of $1 billion in transformation-related savings
An ETR of approximately 25% prior to the MTM retirement plans accounting adjustments

prior_guidance_check.quote: A 5% to 6% revenue growth rate year over year

red_flags.label: Freight shipments and volume down; FedEx Freight profit down 71%
red_flags.quote: FedEx Freight segment operating results decreased during the quarter due to lower shipments

red_flags.label: GAAP EPS unforecastable due to pension MTM
red_flags.quote: FedEx is unable to provide a fiscal 2026 earnings per share ("EPS") or effective tax rate ("ETR") outlook on a GAAP basis
